# stapel-referrals 0.1.0

Referral codes, attribution and rewards. Every member gets one personal code (minted lazily, collision-proof; vanity codes by policy) and a share link; staff issue campaign codes with a window and an attribution cap. A visitor's client stores the code on the first visit and claims it right after sign-up: the account is attributed once (unique constraint, first touch wins), self-referral, old accounts, stale captures and closed or used-up campaign codes are refused, and opt-in guards (same device, duplicate contact, custom) can refuse a claim with a recorded reason. Reward rules fire on facts — sign-up (user.signed_up), the first qualifying order or the Nth order (orders.order.placed) — for the referrer, the referee or both, with caps per referrer per rolling period and budgets counted under a lock on the rule row. The reward ledger is idempotent per (rule, attribution, trigger, role), holds order rewards for a period, rejects them when the order is cancelled during the hold and reverses them after it. Rewards are paid by a strategy that calls the paying brick by comm Function (billing_credit, promo_code) or just records them (noop); the module never imports auth, orders, billing or promotions.

Contract: axes 4 · surface 6 · extension points 7 · operations 17 · error codes 63 · flows 3.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- CLAIM_REQUIRES_ACCOUNT [bool, default false] — Guests can use an invitation
  false (default): a guest session may claim a code; the claim follows the guest into its account. true: only signed-in members can claim. Values: true, false.
- HOLD_DAYS [enum, default 14] — Days before an order reward is paid
  How long a reward earned by an order waits before it is paid (default 14), so a cancelled or returned order earns nothing. Sign-up rewards are paid at once unless a rule says otherwise. Values: 0 to 365.
- REFEREE_DISPLAY [enum, default "masked"] — What inviters see of their friends
  masked (default): the referrer's list shows a masked e-mail (a***@e***.com) per friend. hidden: no label at all, only dates and rewards. Values: hidden, masked.
- VANITY_CODES [enum, default "off"] — Members choose their own code
  off (default): every member keeps the code minted for them. staff: staff accounts may choose one. users: every signed-in member may choose one (guests never). A replaced code keeps working for links already shared. Values: off, staff, users.

## Usage surface — call these before writing your own
This is the answer to "does Stapel already have something for X?". `instead of` names the outside symbol this one displaces.
### gate_function
- call_function — stapel_referrals.strategies.call_function
  Call the comm Function named by a settings key from a strategy; any provider failure (unreachable, raised, malformed) becomes StrategyError so the reward is retried, never refused.
### predicate
- idempotency_key — stapel_referrals.strategies.idempotency_key
  The idempotency key a strategy sends with every outbound call for a reward (suffix ':reverse' for a reversal), so the beat may retry freely.
- params_problem — stapel_referrals.strategies.params_problem
  Why a params dict breaks a strategy's params_schema (JSON Schema 2020-12), or None; rule writes call it before clean_params.
- registered_strategies — stapel_referrals.strategies.registered_strategies
  Every registered strategy that resolves, as (name, instance) sorted by name; what GET staff/strategies/ lists.
- strategy_paths — stapel_referrals.strategies.strategy_paths
  The effective strategy registry: built-ins merged with REWARD_STRATEGIES (None removes).
### factory
- get_strategy — stapel_referrals.strategies.get_strategy
  A strategy instance for a registered name or a dotted path; LookupError when it does not resolve (rule writes answer error.400.reward_strategy_unknown).

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- ATTRIBUTION_GUARDS [strategy]
  Opt-in claim guards: same_device, duplicate_contact or dotted paths (ClaimContext) -> reason | None. A reason records a refused attribution that keeps the account's slot; an unmeasurable guard returns None.
- REWARD_STRATEGIES [merge_registry]
  How a reward is paid. {name: 'dotted.Strategy' | None} merged over noop, billing_credit and promo_code; a rule may also name a dotted path. A strategy cleans its params, states the value counted against budgets, grants with an idempotency key and reverses; StrategyError means 'not now' and the beat retries; StrategyRefused rejects the reward with the provider's reason; reverse() may return a Reversal (reversed_partial / already_spent).
- SHARE_URL_TEMPLATE [setting]
  The share link, a template with {code}; empty answers link null rather than a guessed URL (check E003).
- STAPEL_REFERRALS_ME_PRESENTER / _CLAIM_PRESENTER / _REFERRAL_PRESENTER / _REWARD_PRESENTER / _STAFF_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for every response presenter, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.
- orders.order.placed [comm_event]
  Consumed: an order placed by an attributed referee inside the qualifying window fires the first-order and Nth-order rules it qualifies for (currency, minimum total).
- referrals.reward.granted [comm_event]
  A reward was paid (ids, role, value, unit — never an issued code or a contact), for notifications and projections. Siblings: referrals.reward.rejected, referrals.reward.reversed, referrals.attribution.created.
- user.signed_up [comm_event]
  Consumed: writes the signup marker (auth's clock for the account age) and fires the signup rules of an attributed account.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-auth (optional) — user.signed_up fires the signup rules and dates the account; user.merged moves a guest's codes and attribution to the account; a guest row may claim a code
- stapel-billing (optional) — the billing_credit strategy pays wallet credits through billing.credit (stapel-billing >= 0.25.0) and reverses through billing.debit without recording debt
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (referrals.* emits, Functions, user.signed_up / user.merged / orders.* consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings
- stapel-notifications (optional) — delivers referrals.reward_granted to the beneficiary
- stapel-orders (optional) — orders.order.placed fires first-order and Nth-order rules; orders.order.status_changed to cancelled rejects or reverses their rewards
- stapel-promotions (optional) — the promo_code strategy issues a single-use code of an existing promotion, assigned to the beneficiary, through promotions.codes.issue with an idempotency key and revokes it through promotions.codes.revoke (stapel-promotions 0.1.0)

## HTTP operations (17) — call by operationId, never by a typed path
Paths are relative to `/referrals/api/v1/`.

- POST /claim/ — referrals_claim_create
